interpretation.primary: Both matches fail the frozen point gate; intervals contain zero, not evidence of universal MoE inferiority.
interpretation.incomplete: At2/255 MoE23/3000 versus2/3000 eachdense; +0.7pp interval[0.4,1.0667], but higher median cost. Secondary does not override complete primary.
interpretation.radius8: All groups/modes zero positives. Raw per-comparison ENTER_S2 field at8/255 is a mechanical secondary point calculation, not the study decision. Cheap clean-error returns shift medians.
interpretation.routes: Conservative numerical candidate counts only, not exact legal-history counts or checked route-changing witnesses.
interpretation.uncertainty: Shared fixed inputs with three fixed seeds; historical exposure, architecture-specific balance loss, and finite MLP family limit generalization.
interpretation.guarantee: Numerical-policy results. Audit checks record identity, online acceptance, complete obligations and replay records; not independent source/model/arithmetic reproof.
